title: Gate values in satisfying assignments
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits, and let $z$ assign an element of $\mathbb{F}_2$ to each of its $1+n+g$ variables, where $g$ is the number of gates. If $z$ satisfies the circuit’s homogeneous quadratic system, then for every gate $i$, its variable equals the $\mathbb{F}_2$ encoding of the Boolean value of gate $i$ on the input decoded from the input variables of $z$.
hypotheses_covered: An assignment to the circuit’s $1+n+g$ variables
The assignment satisfies the circuit’s homogeneous quadratic system
